parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The product of PageNumber and PageSize cannot exceed 50,000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 50. Maximum value: 100.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn list-dcdn-kv --namespace ns1 --page-size 50 --page-number 10 --prefix prefix- --region cn-hangzhou
